From Michigan to the moon 🚀
 
We're so proud to watch Grand Rapids native and the first woman orbiting the moon, Christina Koch, take off on this historic mission. 
 
Good luck to Christina and the Artemis II crew as they travel farther from Earth than any humans before!


NASA (@NASA)

Liftoff.

The Artemis II mission launched from @NASAKennedy at 6:35pm ET (2235 UTC), propelling four astronauts on a journey around the Moon.

Artemis II will pave the way for future Moon landings, as well as the
As our Jewish friends and neighbors across the state gather with family tonight in celebration of Passover, I’d like to wish every Michigander celebrating, Chag Pesach Sameach!

Right now, there’s not enough housing and what is available is too damn expensive.  We must come together to create an affordable housing tax credit and cut red tape so we can build more homes and lower costs.

Video
From business to food, culture to faith, we are so grateful for the contributions of Arab Michiganders.

In April, we celebrate the rich legacy and contributions of our Arab American community. As the home of the highest concentration of people of Arab descent in the U.S., Michigan is better because of our Arab neighbors.

Today’s Supreme Court ruling is disappointing, but it does not change who we are. Michigan will never support any practice that harms or shames LGBTQ+ youth. As long as I'm governor, I will protect every young person’s right to grow up safe, supported, and free to be themselves.

To every transgender Michigander: your courage to live openly in a world that doesn’t always make space for you is powerful.
 
I will always have your back 🏳️‍⚧️

Video

Almost 40,000 miles, 1,500 towns, all 83 counties, and two determined St. Clair County sisters on a mission to experience every corner of Michigan.
 
Meet the duo: ✨Theresa Richey and Susan Zmijski✨

Video

Today at Brush Park Apartments, I met Michiganders getting the shot they deserve: a place they can afford in a community they’re proud to call home. This should be possible everywhere.
 If we want Michigan to grow, we have to make it easier for people to build their lives here.
If you're looking to kick-start your family's education journey, visit MiPreKforAll.org to enroll in a free preK program that suits your needs!

We’ve reached a HUGE new milestone!

Michigan now has a record nearly 55,000 kids enrolled in our free preK program.

📖 That’s 55,000 students learning to read earlier

💸 That’s 55,000 families saving $14,000 annually

🏫 That’s 55,000 kids getting the strong start they deserve
Big news from our littlest Michiganders coming soon 👀

Today, I extended the state of emergency I declared last week to Osceola County, freeing up additional state resources for the area following extreme winter weather.
 
We will continue to support northern Michigan with our all hands on deck response as recovery efforts carry on.

Today I met some incredible teachers helping their students “break it down and sound it out” 🎵
 
These LETRS trained teachers are using phonics to kick-start reading for our youngest Michiganders and help every child read.

I'm calling on the legislature to come together and pass an affordable housing tax credit and make it easier to build in communities across the state.
 
We all want to help every Michigander achieve their American dream. Let’s work together and get this done.
We’ve made historic investments, but red tape and burdensome zoning are preventing shovels from hitting dirt and more houses from being built.

An affordable home is the American dream.
 
-If we want more young people to choose Michigan.
 
-If we want to make Michigan the best place to live, work, and raise a family.
 
-If we want to grow Michigan’s population and build a brighter future for our kids.
 
We need to ACT.

Today, I'm at the beautiful Seymour apartments, a game-changing development that turned a blighted property into 27 mixed-income apartments. Every Michigander deserves an affordable place like this to call home.

Coast to coast, east to west…

Michigan DOES hockey 🏒


NCAA Ice Hockey (@NCAAIceHockey)

The 2026 Men's Ice Hockey stage is set 🏒🏆

➡️ on.ncaa.com/aws0ozyy
🎟️ on.ncaa.com/Mens-Frozen-Four…

#NCAAHockey





— https://nitter.net/NCAAIceHockey/status/2035817529604550954#m

We’ve taken action to:

✅Codify ACA protections into state law
✅Lower prescription drug costs
✅Protect Medicaid funding
✅Erase $144 million in medical debt

And so much more. 

I’m ready to continue protecting Michiganders’ access to quality, affordable care and lower costs.
